programs.title: Guddi
programs.desc: Kusum is obsessed with Bollywood movies and is unable to distinguish between the real world and the movie world, to the extent that she refuses to marry anyone besides her idol, Dharmendra.

programs.title: Besharam
programs.desc: When a mayor is falsely implicated in a corruption case he is sent into a spiral of depression that eventually ends in him committing suicide. Years later, the mayor's son returns to teach the man who made the accusation a lesson.

programs.title: Andaz
programs.desc: Sheetal, a widow, is a school teacher and lives with her son after her husband's death. She meets her student's father Ravi, a widower, and decides to marry him.

programs.title: Kudrat
programs.desc: Chandramukhi visits Shimla and learns that she is a reincarnation of Paro, a girl who was raped and murdered. Plagued by her dark past, she attempts to bring the culprits to justice.
